record.question: Does Del Valle currently have 150 family campsites, or the 143 family-category entries exposed by its live booking inventory?
record.reason: The official overview/camping surfaces publish 150 as 124 tent, 21 RV, and five cabins; the complete live booking listing publishes 118 tent, 20 RV, and five cabins. Seven numbers from 1 through 150 have no listing.
